descriptionHtml:
Memory foam over egg-crate. Three walls, and a clear way out.

Rosthwaite is a memory foam bolster dog bed with three bolstered sides, an open front, a fleece surface and a zipped cover. One size, measurements not listed.

Watch a stiff dog leave a fully enclosed bed at six in the morning. Front end up, stop at the wall, a long think, then a scramble.

Three sides here carry the leaning and the fourth is left open, so standing up costs them a step forward instead of a climb.

What they get

  • Two layers of foam: Memory foam for contour over egg-crate foam for support.
  • Bolsters on three sides: A chin rest and a back rest, with the front clear.
  • Fleece between the bolsters: A soft surface exactly where they lie.
  • A zipped cover and a base that grips: It comes off to wash and the bed keeps its spot.

Best for: dogs who have started avoiding a walled bed, and hard floors.

Why it is worth the money

Most beds at £165 use one foam layer or none. This uses two, and the shape is chosen so a stiff dog can still get out of it in five years. Five years is 1825 nights of no-flatten guarantee on the core, so £165 is about 9p a night. The decision is not final on the day it lands either: 100 nights, free UK mainland collection, full refund.

Here is the honest gap. We do not publish outside measurements for Rosthwaite and we will not estimate them, because a wrong number is a bed that comes back. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Size and fit

One size, and its outside measurements are not listed on this page. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm, then send us that number with their breed and weight. The bolsters take up part of the outside footprint.

Everyday care

Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

How big is it?

The measurements are not published, so ask us before ordering.

Is delivery charged?

Not over £40. Your postcode window appears at the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

Why leave one side open?

Because a wall is easy to step over at four and hard at eleven.

Does it suit a stiff dog?

That is the shape it was chosen for. Your vet should confirm the rest.

Can I actually wash it?

Unzip, wash by the label, dry right through, zip back on.

What if they will not use it?

The 100 nights cover that. We collect and refund you in full.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Ask us the size first, then give them three sides and a way out.
